guitar.guitaristsText: Phil Collen / Vivian Campbell (formerly Steve Clark)
guitar.modelsText: Jackson / Ibanez (Phil Collen signature Jackson PC1)
guitar.evidence: Phil Collen has a long-running Jackson PC1 signature model; Steve Clark (original guitarist) was known for Gibson Les Paul/Jackson.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with reasonably well documented info.

tone.target: polished 80s arena rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: polished 80s arena rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A polished, mid-gain signal chain utilizing a UK Marshall style amp (UK SLP) combined with Chorus and slight compression to achieve the signature bright, crunchy sound of 80s arena rock.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from high-gain passages.
Tighten the attack and sustain for palm-muted rhythm parts.
Provide the necessary mid-range crunch and grit without excessive modern saturation.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is a general overdrive, but it provides the classic British midrange punch needed for 80s rock better than pure OD models.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if more vintage warmth is desired.

blocks.purpose: Add the signature 'chorus sheen' and width required for 80s arena rock texture.
Simulate the classic British Marshall/JCM style amp tone (UK SLP) for high-headroom crunch.
Provide the classic British cabinet voicing and punchy midrange response.
Boost the upper mids and high frequencies to achieve 'bright upper mids' and cut through a mix.
Add a subtle 'light delay' echo for depth without muddying the crunch.
Add subtle space and polish to the overall tone (arena rock sheen).

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better 80s arena rock punch.

proposals.recommendedAsset: vintage British 4x12 IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback/V30 style)
proposals.reason: Enhance the classic Marshall midrange bite and punch.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and definition in rhythm parts.
